titles.romaji: Onaji Zemi no Someya-san ga Sexy Joyuu Datta Hanashi.
titles.english: My Classmate’s a Sexy Actress, and Now We Live Together?!
titles.native: 同じゼミの染谷さんがセクシー女優だった話。

description:
The protagonist is in the middle of preparing for a presentation at a college seminar.

Ryousuke Kamiya, a college student, was browsing porn videos while taking a break when he stumbles upon a video featuring Yuuka Someya, a girl attending the same seminar! When he asks her about the video at a drinking party after the presentation, he finds himself being offered sex in exchange for not telling anybody about it...?!

(Source: DLsite, translated)

Note: Episode 1 receives an advance distribution on AnimeFesta on June 12th, 2026. The start date reflects the start of the regular series broadcasting.
